ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Padiush records interview audio and voice notes on field records.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Padiush saves where each interview and each field record was made.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Padiush uses the camera to take photos for interviews and field records.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Padiush attaches photos from your library to interviews and field records.
